acme-superapp.title: acme-superapp
acme-superapp.bitriseYml:
format_version: "13"
default_step_lib_source: https://github.com/bitrise-io/bitrise-steplib.git
project_type: other

meta:
  bitrise.io:
    stack: osx-xcode-16.0.x
    machine_type_id: g2.mac.medium

app:
  envs:
  - APPLE_TEAM_ID: 7ABC123XYZ
  - NODE_VERSION: "22"

include:
- path: ci/shared/containers.yml
- path: ci/shared/step-bundles.yml
- path: ci/ios/ios.yml
- path: ci/android/android.yml
- path: ci/backend/api.yml
- path: ci/pipelines.yml
- repository: acme/bitrise-shared-ci
  branch: main
  path: templates/notifications.yml
- repository: acme/bitrise-shared-ci
  tag: v3.2.0
  path: templates/security-scans.yml
- repository: acme/design-tokens
  commit: 9f2c1ab
  path: ci/tokens.yml

step_bundles:
  notify-team:
    summary: Posts the build result to the team channel
    inputs:
    - channel: "#superapp-ci"
    steps:
    - slack@4:
        inputs:
        - channel: $channel
        - webhook_url: $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL

workflows:
  smoke-test:
    summary: Fast sanity check of every app target before the full suites run
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Build all targets
        execution_container: node
        inputs:
        - content: ./scripts/smoke.sh
    - bundle::notify-team: {}
  deploy-docs:
    summary: Publishes the developer docs site
    triggers:
      push:
      - branch: main
        changed_files: docs/**
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Build and publish docs
        execution_container: node
        inputs:
        - content: npm run docs:publish

pipelines:
  hotfix:
    triggers:
      push:
      - branch: hotfix/*
    workflows:
      smoke-test: {}
      ios-archive-testflight:
        depends_on:
        - smoke-test
      android-build-aab:
        depends_on:
        - smoke-test
      notify-release:
        depends_on:
        - ios-archive-testflight
        - android-build-aab

includes.contents:
containers:
  node:
    type: execution
    image: node:22-bookworm
  ruby:
    type: execution
    image: ruby:3.3
  postgres:
    type: service
    image: postgres:16
    ports:
    - 5432:5432
    envs:
    - POSTGRES_PASSWORD: $POSTGRES_PASSWORD
    options: --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-retries 5
  redis:
    type: service
    image: redis:7
    ports:
    - 6379:6379

step_bundles:
  checkout:
    summary: SSH key, clone and the build's shared cache
    inputs:
    - cache_key: '{{ .OS }}-{{ .Arch }}-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}'
    steps:
    - activate-ssh-key@4:
        run_if: '{{getenv "SSH_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY" | ne ""}}'
    - git-clone@8:
        inputs:
        - fetch_depth: 50
    - restore-cache@2:
        inputs:
        - key: $cache_key
  upload-results:
    summary: Test reports and artifacts to the build page
    steps:
    - deploy-to-bitrise-io@2:
        inputs:
        - notify_user_groups: none
  save-build-cache:
    steps:
    - save-cache@1:
        inputs:
        - key: '{{ .OS }}-{{ .Arch }}-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}'
        - paths: node_modules

include:
- path: ci/ios/testing.yml
- path: ci/ios/release.yml

workflows:
  _ios-setup:
    summary: Checkout, Swift packages and CocoaPods
    envs:
    - IOS_WORKSPACE: ios/SuperApp.xcworkspace
    - IOS_SCHEME: SuperApp
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - bundle::xcode-cache: {}
    - cocoapods-install@2:
        inputs:
        - source_root_path: ios

step_bundles:
  xcode-cache:
    summary: Swift packages and derived data from the last build
    steps:
    - restore-spm-cache@1: {}
    - restore-xcode-derived-data-cache@1: {}

workflows:
  ios-unit-tests:
    summary: Unit test plan on the latest simulator
    before_run:
    - _ios-setup
    steps:
    - xcode-test@5:
        inputs:
        - project_path: $IOS_WORKSPACE
        - scheme: $IOS_SCHEME
        - test_plan: UnitTests
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  ios-ui-tests:
    summary: UI tests, split across simulators
    before_run:
    - _ios-setup
    steps:
    - xcode-build-for-test@3:
        inputs:
        - project_path: $IOS_WORKSPACE
        - scheme: $IOS_SCHEME
    - xcode-test-without-building@0:
        inputs:
        - destination: platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16,OS=latest
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  ios-snapshot-tests:
    summary: Snapshot tests against the design system's reference images
    before_run:
    - _ios-setup
    steps:
    - xcode-test@5:
        inputs:
        - test_plan: SnapshotTests
    - bundle::upload-results: {}

include:
- path: ci/ios/signing.yml

workflows:
  ios-archive-testflight:
    summary: Signed archive to TestFlight for internal testers
    envs:
    - IOS_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD: app-store
    before_run:
    - _ios-setup
    - _ios-codesigning
    steps:
    - xcode-archive@5:
        inputs:
        - project_path: $IOS_WORKSPACE
        - scheme: $IOS_SCHEME
        - distribution_method: $IOS_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD
    - deploy-to-itunesconnect-application-loader@1: {}
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  ios-release-appstore:
    summary: Submits the TestFlight build for App Store review
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - fastlane@3:
        inputs:
        - lane: ios submit_for_review

workflows:
  _ios-codesigning:
    summary: Installs certificates and profiles for the distribution method
    steps:
    - certificate-and-profile-installer@1: {}
    - manage-ios-code-signing@2:
        inputs:
        - distribution_method: $IOS_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD
        - apple_team_id: $APPLE_TEAM_ID

include:
- path: ci/android/testing.yml
- path: ci/android/release.yml

workflows:
  _android-setup:
    meta:
      bitrise.io:
        stack: ubuntu-jammy-22.04-bitrise-2024
        machine_type_id: standard
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - restore-gradle-cache@2: {}
    - set-java-version@1:
        inputs:
        - set_java_version: "17"

pipelines:
  android-pr:
    triggers:
      pull_request:
      - source_branch: "*"
        changed_files: android/**
    workflows:
      android-lint: {}
      android-unit-tests: {}
      android-instrumented-tests:
        depends_on:
        - android-unit-tests

workflows:
  android-lint:
    before_run:
    - _android-setup
    steps:
    - android-lint@0:
        inputs:
        - project_location: android
        - module: app
  android-unit-tests:
    before_run:
    - _android-setup
    steps:
    - android-unit-test@1:
        inputs:
        - project_location: android
        - module: app
        - variant: debug
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  android-instrumented-tests:
    summary: Instrumented tests on Firebase Test Lab
    before_run:
    - _android-setup
    steps:
    - android-build-for-ui-testing@0:
        inputs:
        - project_location: android
        - module: app
        - variant: debug
    - virtual-device-testing-for-android@1:
        inputs:
        - test_type: instrumentation
    - bundle::upload-results: {}

workflows:
  android-build-aab:
    summary: Signed App Bundle
    before_run:
    - _android-setup
    steps:
    - android-build@1:
        inputs:
        - project_location: android
        - module: app
        - variant: release
        - build_type: aab
    - sign-apk@1: {}
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  android-release-play:
    summary: App Bundle to the Google Play internal track
    after_run:
    - android-build-aab
    steps:
    - google-play-deploy@3:
        inputs:
        - package_name: com.acme.superapp
        - track: internal

workflows:
  api-tests:
    summary: API test suite against Postgres and Redis
    meta:
      bitrise.io:
        stack: ubuntu-jammy-22.04-bitrise-2024
        machine_type_id: standard
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Install and test
        execution_container: node
        service_containers:
        - postgres
        - redis
        inputs:
        - content: |-
            cd api
            npm ci
            npm test
    - bundle::save-build-cache: {}
    - bundle::upload-results: {}
  api-deploy-staging:
    summary: Deploys the API to staging
    steps:
    - bundle::checkout: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Deploy
        execution_container: node
        inputs:
        - content: cd api && npm run deploy -- --env staging

pipelines:
  pr-validation:
    triggers:
      pull_request:
      - source_branch: "*"
        draft_pull_request_enabled: false
    workflows:
      ios-unit-tests: {}
      android-lint: {}
      android-unit-tests: {}
      api-tests: {}
      security-scan: {}
      ios-ui-tests:
        depends_on:
        - ios-unit-tests
      android-instrumented-tests:
        depends_on:
        - android-unit-tests
  release:
    triggers:
      push:
      - branch: main
    workflows:
      ios-unit-tests: {}
      android-unit-tests: {}
      api-tests: {}
      ios-archive-testflight:
        depends_on:
        - ios-unit-tests
      android-build-aab:
        depends_on:
        - android-unit-tests
      api-deploy-staging:
        depends_on:
        - api-tests
      notify-release:
        depends_on:
        - ios-archive-testflight
        - android-build-aab
        - api-deploy-staging
  nightly:
    workflows:
      ios-snapshot-tests: {}
      android-instrumented-tests: {}
      dependency-audit: {}
      sync-design-tokens: {}
  ios-store-release:
    triggers:
      tag:
      - name: ios/v*
    workflows:
      ios-archive-testflight: {}
      ios-release-appstore:
        depends_on:
        - ios-archive-testflight
  android-store-release:
    triggers:
      tag:
      - name: android/v*
    workflows:
      android-release-play: {}

# Maintained by the Platform team. Changes go through acme/bitrise-shared-ci.
step_bundles:
  shared-notify:
    inputs:
    - channel: "#builds"
    steps:
    - slack@4:
        inputs:
        - channel: $channel
        - webhook_url: $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL

workflows:
  notify-release:
    summary: Posts the release summary to Slack
    steps:
    - bundle::shared-notify:
        inputs:
        - channel: "#releases"

workflows:
  security-scan:
    summary: Secret detection and SAST
    steps:
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Gitleaks
        inputs:
        - content: gitleaks detect --redact --exit-code 1
  dependency-audit:
    summary: Known-vulnerability audit of every package manifest
    steps:
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - script@1:
        title: OSV scanner
        inputs:
        - content: osv-scanner --recursive .

workflows:
  sync-design-tokens:
    summary: Regenerates platform tokens from the design-tokens repo
    steps:
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - script@1:
        title: Build tokens
        inputs:
        - content: npx style-dictionary build --config tokens.config.json

my-ios-app.title: my-ios-app
my-ios-app.bitriseYml:
format_version: "13"
default_step_lib_source: https://github.com/bitrise-io/bitrise-steplib.git
project_type: ios

meta:
  bitrise.io:
    stack: osx-xcode-16.0.x
    machine_type_id: g2.mac.medium

app:
  envs:
  - BITRISE_PROJECT_PATH: MyApp.xcodeproj
  - BITRISE_SCHEME: MyApp
  - BITRISE_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD: app-store

pipelines:
  pr-validation:
    triggers:
      pull_request:
      - source_branch: "*"
    workflows:
      unit-tests: {}
      ui-tests: {}
  release:
    triggers:
      push:
      - branch: main
    workflows:
      unit-tests: {}
      archive-and-deploy:
        depends_on:
        - unit-tests

workflows:
  unit-tests:
    summary: Runs the unit test plan
    steps:
    - activate-ssh-key@4:
        run_if: '{{getenv "SSH_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY" | ne ""}}'
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - restore-spm-cache@1: {}
    - xcode-test@5:
        inputs:
        - test_plan: UnitTests
    - save-spm-cache@1: {}
    - deploy-to-bitrise-io@2: {}
  ui-tests:
    summary: Runs the UI tests on an iPhone simulator
    steps:
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - restore-spm-cache@1: {}
    - xcode-test@5:
        inputs:
        - test_plan: UITests
        - destination: platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16,OS=latest
    - deploy-to-bitrise-io@2: {}
  archive-and-deploy:
    summary: Archives a signed build and uploads it to App Store Connect
    steps:
    - git-clone@8: {}
    - restore-spm-cache@1: {}
    - manage-ios-code-signing@2:
        inputs:
        - distribution_method: $BITRISE_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD
    - xcode-archive@5:
        inputs:
        - distribution_method: $BITRISE_DISTRIBUTION_METHOD
        - automatic_code_signing: api-key
    - deploy-to-itunesconnect-application-loader@1: {}
    - deploy-to-bitrise-io@2: {}
    - slack@4:
        inputs:
        - channel: "#ios-releases"
